mechanism: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin, potentially increasing loperamide levels and CNS effects; loperamide has opioid-like properties and can cause constipation which may complicate heart failure management in sacubitril users.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression and constipation; consider alternative antidiarrheals; use loperamide at lowest effective dose with caution in heart failure patients on sacubitril.
